senses.gloss: m. pl. (גרם) that which goes along, customary addition to weight or measure at sales.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 6:11">B. Bath. VI, 11</cite> <he>נותן לו גֵּירוּמָיו</he> (Bab. ed. 88ᵇ <he>מין …</he>, Y. ed. … <he>מים</he>) he must give him the due surplus. Sifra K’doshim Par. 9, ch. VIII.
